title: FIRST DAY of SOPHOMORE YEAR! 🎒🎀 High School Vlog + GRWM
description:

If you love *back to school vlogs*, *high school morning routines*, or want to see what the first day of sophomore year really looks like, this one’s for you.  

This is one of my FAVORITE videos to film every year, and it’s always the MOST exciting! 💌
